text:
```yaml
name: E2E Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v4
      with:
        go-version: '1.19'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y bats jq curl

    - name: Build Docker image
      run: make docker-build

    - name: Start test cluster
      run: make start-cluster

    - name: Run E2E tests
      run: make e2e TEST_STARTUP_TIMEOUT=120s

    - name: Collect container logs on failure
      if: ${{ failure() }}
      run: make collect-logs

    - name: Clean up resources
      always: true
      run: make clean
```
